capabilities: Open any local folder as a collapsible mind map of folders and files
Search indexed file and folder names across the scanned tree
Rename and move files and folders via context menu or drag and drop
Preview and open files from map nodes
Show folder sizes, file counts and frontmatter comment properties
disambiguation: Not a mind-mapping tool for note content; it maps the file system, so the nodes are folders and files, not ideas or notes.
extras: Desktop only (uses Node.js directly, does not work on mobile). Button captions in the shipped UI are Russian, with English localization stated as the next step. Moves and renames are irreversible and bypass the Obsidian trash; the community plugin scan findings are addressed in a dedicated security section.
motivation: The author wants Obsidian to help manage not just notes in the vault but the folder structure of the whole computer.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer only shows folders inside the vault; there is no way to visualize, search or reorganize directories elsewhere on disk from within the app.
summary: Folder explorer that renders any directory, inside or outside the vault, as an interactive mind map with sizes, search and rename/move operations.
